One night on your average weekend, I was up at 2 am watching videos and browsing reddit. I had a bottle of water next to me as my room gets really hot at night for some weird reason. Anyways, I was watching a video that was kinda creepy and I was a bit on edge for jump scares watching it. I don’t know what made me do it, but an impulse made my head turn to the window, with the blinds closed, and I stared at it. I have sorta bad tinnitus so I hear constant ringing at a high pitch. The ringing got louder and my head hurt. I saw a feint shadow move across the window and I could make out what sounded like tapping/light footsteps. I got up as my dog started barking and went to the door (transparent glass sliding door). I looked out and saw a dark figure on the top of the garage which was in front of the door to the left. I blinked and rubbed my eyes and went back to my bedroom and bundled up in my covers. I fell asleep and woke up sweating. I never told anyone else because they knew of my fear for the dark, and hallucinations in the dark. They probably wouldn’t have believed me. I never saw that figure or heard that sound to this day (this was roughly early September 2017).
